notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a black creature onto the battlefield under your control.
description:
Put a black creature onto the battlefield under your control.
Shadow Alley Denizen triggers, targeting any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Overseer of the Damned's second ability triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
